title: Text Volume Chapter 551 I Am Safe
content:
Text Volume Chapter 551 I Am Safe

"I am at peace, and the world is at peace. How is Guizhou Province at peace?"

At the Jimo Township School, Hei Fu held a simple copper trumpet and repeated Qin Shihuang's oral instructions three times.

The whole market suddenly became quiet. Rich households, merchants, light knights, and Qian Shou all looked at each other, and the expressions on their faces were extremely exciting.

Seeing this, Heifu showed a smile.

"As expected."

Unlike ordinary people, from Heifu's perspective, what happened was more thrilling...

Ever since Qin Shihuang left Jiaodong and went to inspect Langya and Donghai, Heifu had been immersed in the busy work of chasing local tyrants to allocate land, as well as shipbuilding and recruiting troops.

When the news came that Qin Shihuang was assassinated on a mountain road south of Ju County in Langya County in early March, he was shocked!

Heifu's first reaction was: "Zhang Liang, Bolangsha, accidentally hit the passenger car?"

Heifu still has this bit of knowledge. When he was in Xianyang, he asked Zhang Cang indirectly where Bolangsha was. Guess what the result was? Bolangsha is in Zhang Cang’s hometown, Yangwu County!

Heifu also inquired about Zhang Liang, a Korean, but in the end it was fruitless. He only knew that this person was the eldest son of Han Prime Minister Zhang, the 21st year of Qin Shihuang, which was the second year of Heifu's time travel. After the Xinzheng Rebellion, His whereabouts are unknown, and there is no way to find him, because in the past eleven years, there has been no trace of him in the world.

Instead of being reassured, Heifu became even more vigilant.

"As expected of Zhang Zifang, such a person is a dangerous person who knows how to protect himself and wait for the right moment!"

The worst part is, you know he's going to attack, but you don't know when or where.

However, with the great changes in history, Qin Shihuang took action against the Xiongnu first due to Heifu's suggestion to expand the west, and postponed his eastward patrol. When he set out this time, he did not pass through Yangwu County at all, but went to Chenliu, On the first line of Dingtao, we entered Xuejun from the danger of Kangfu.

Heifu followed during the subsequent trip to Mount Tai and Linzi. After arriving in Jiaodong, he personally took care of all the security and guidance along the way. Everything was very smooth and nothing happened. Once something happened, no matter what happened to the emperor, as a county guard, a You can't run away if you neglect your duty.

In short, when sending Qin Shihuang out of Jiaodong, Hei Fu breathed a sigh of relief. He thought that Bolangsha was completely gone, but he never expected that something happened in Junan. Although it is speculated that Zhang Liang may have been assassinated late, the news that came was ambiguous. Qin Shihuang was an extremely cautious person. Only those around him knew about his life and death. To the county guards, he only sent an edict, asking them to search the world, investigate suspicious persons, and dig deep to find the assassins!

Heifu complied with the instructions one by one, but when he thought about it carefully, he couldn't help but feel a shiver down his spine.

Historically, after the death of Qin Shihuang, the news of his death was covered up by Li Si and Zhao Gao. The funeral was kept secret and everything continued as usual. Anyway, the emperor was secretive on weekdays and did not like to easily reveal his whereabouts to outsiders. According to more legendary accounts, he also used Several carts of abalone were used to cover up the increasingly strong body odor...

Of course, Heifu would wonder if the emperor's situation in the imperial palace was unclear this time. Is history happening in advance?

What would happen if Qin Shihuang died now, and was assassinated?

Heifu always had a great imagination, so he quietly figured it out...

…

The first thing Heifu thought of was: "Will Zhao Gao cause trouble like in history?"

After careful consideration, Heifu optimistically discovered that if something unexpected happened to Qin Shihuang, Zhao Gao, as the charioteer, would not be able to shirk his responsibility. Ye Teng, the father-in-law, knew that Hei Fu had a conflict with Zhao Gao. As a court lieutenant, it was not impossible to take Zhao Gao to jail on the spot. Besides, thinking on the bright side, maybe it was Zhao Gao who was killed by that vertebra? That would be interesting.

If Emperor Qin Shi Huang dies, there are two possibilities: one is that he left a posthumous edict, and the other is that he did not leave a posthumous edict.

If the imperial edict was to be left, it could only be the young master Fusu, because the young master Hu Hai was still young, thirteen or fourteen years old, and the country's chief minister. Even if the emperor didn't like Fusu, he would not choose a young master to ascend the throne.

Although Ziying was with the emperor, he was just a fifth official, the son of the traitor Chang'an Lord, and had no qualifications to succeed to the throne.

If there is no edict and Qin Shihuang has no prince, he will have to choose from among the princes.

It may be that the three big bosses Li Si, Wang Ben, and Ye Teng discussed and made the decision. According to the traditional patriarchal system, there are direct descendants and no direct descendants. In the absence of other candidates, Fusu is still the first heir.

And don’t forget, Fusu is not somewhere else, but in Xianyang! And he is very friendly with brothers Meng Tian.

Meng Tian and Li Xin guarded the northwest, with tens of thousands of troops. After learning the news, it was easy to return to Guanzhong to guard. Li Si was a civil servant. Even if his son Li You guarded Sanchuan, he would not dare to mess around with the succession of the emperor when faced with Meng Tian who could not stop him.

Therefore, Heifu put himself in Li Si's shoes and considered that his best choice was to help Su succeed the throne and use his support in exchange for continuing to be prime minister. At most, Wang Ben was recruited and made the Taiwei, and Li Wang cooperated to carve up the government and isolate the court lieutenant Ye Teng.

"So in terms of the impact on the central government alone, the death of Qin Shihuang at this time may still be a bad thing. The timing is just right and the regime will transition smoothly."

But this situation will last until the world is in chaos.

That's right, the world is in chaos!

Different from natural death, if Qin Shihuang died in an assassination, it would be a signal, a signal to encourage the remaining people of the Six Kingdoms to rise up in rebellion!

The wind stirred by the wings of a small butterfly has greatly affected the times, and many places are different from the original.

Let’s not talk about other places, let’s talk about Qidi. Because Hei Fu came to Jiaodong to be the county guard, the situation changed drastically!

Although there was an undercurrent surging in Qi, Qin officials did not move the fields, and the fields did not rebel against the Qin Dynasty. They maintained a high degree of autonomy until the end of Qin. However, Hei Fu disturbed this deep water.

He razed the Yeyi Tian family and moved a total of eight families from the Jiaodong fields. This violent demolition obviously added fuel to the barely maintained relationship between Qin officials and the fields.

The balance has been broken, and the situation in Qi is very unstable. With Qin Shihuang here, no one dares to make mistakes, and can only wait for defeat. But if something happens to the First Emperor, as long as there are one or two people in the seventy-two cities who have the guts and would rather live in pieces than in ruins, taking advantage of the news of Qin Shihuang's death, they might actually be able to cause some war!

There are no Zhutian in Jiaodong, but it is still surrounded by Langya, Linzi, and Jibei.

If we just make trouble together, everything will be fine. But if everyone in Guandong rebels, Heifu will be in dire straits.

He was not confident. With thousands of Qin soldiers, thousands of local county soldiers whose loyalty was worrying, and more than 10,000 newly conquered households who could be manipulated at any time, he was able to put down the uprising and hold Jiaodong. Not bad.

If the imperial court fails to send troops in time, or if the war goes unfavorably and the entire Guandong rebels, it is not impossible for Heifu to be surrounded by Qi and Chu heroes and trapped in Jiaodong, a corner of the far east, and finally be forced to cross to North Korea...

Tsk, in that case, he would really be a disgrace to the time traveler.

Although in the long run, Heifu is confident of fighting back, the process is still a bit embarrassing. After the chaos was settled and the situation between the DPRK and China was settled, it would be difficult for Heifu to get another piece of the pie. It would be even more difficult for him to become the actual helmsman of the empire.

"Fortunately, I took care of Liu Ji early..."

Hei Fu couldn't help but complain that the son of the plane was under his claws and could be killed at any time. In a crisis, there was nothing more reassuring than this.

As for defecting to the Qin camp as a Qin official? Well, Neji Okamura, whose hands are stained with the blood of countless people with lofty ideals, suddenly jumped to the Communist Party. Do you believe it? The Xiang family, Zhang Er, Zhu Tian, and Heifu have quite a few enemies.

Furthermore, given the strength of Qin, as long as the central government is not in chaos, it will be difficult for the anti-Qin heroes to win, let alone history being messed up by the black husband. Liu Ji, the main force, has knelt down. Xiang Yu is still underage now, right? Moreover, together with his uncle Xiang Liang, he was moved to Guanzhong and lived in Yueyang City. Hei Fu also sent people to keep an eye on him.

He obviously didn't know that the young man brought by Xiang Liang was actually Xiang Zhuang who pretended to be Xiang Yu...

In short, after thinking about it, Heifu found that it would be very disadvantageous for him if the emperor died at this time.

"My secret plans over the years will be completely disrupted. What I have worked so hard on will be used as a wedding dress for others. Even the ascendant Jiaodong New Deal will be abandoned halfway..."

If the world is about to be in chaos, everything about studying things, applying what you have learned, and cabbage and radishes must be put aside and fight first! Let’s talk until it’s dark! I just hope it can be resolved quickly! Let Huaxia shed less blood, and finally gain the advantage of the wild wolf in Maodun.

History will be like a wild horse, out of Heifu's control. By the time he picks up the bridle again, perhaps twenty or thirty years will have passed.

Once something like the general trend is not grasped, it is not easy to get it back. Heifu could only prepare secretly, and at the same time, he immediately sent his cronies to Donghai County to check the situation and get in touch with Ye Teng.

Fortunately, Heifu's worst plan did not appear. After a few days of delay, more detailed news came, news about Ye Teng!

"Your Majesty is fine!"

…

After Ye Teng described the situation that day in his letter, Heifu found out that although the sudden iron spine hit the emperor's main carriage, it only hit the wheels, causing the carriage to overturn and did not break the window.

Think about it, that big iron vertebra actually only weighs a hundred pounds. It was thrown by human hands, not a cannonball. But how big was Qin Shihuang’s Golden Root Car? Two feet long and one foot wide! It takes six horses to pull it forward, and it is closed. Where does the emperor sit? Whether it is before or after, outsiders have no idea.

The assassin had to guess and accurately hit the emperor's seat at an extreme distance of more than ten feet in order to kill him with one blow. It didn't matter if it was a little crooked, it was very difficult.

In addition, there is good news and bad news.

The good news is that Zhao Gao seemed to be injured in this accident and lost one of his arms. It is said that the bones were broken by being trampled by a frightened horse.

The bad news is that thanks to Zhao Gao's superb driving skills, Kankan made the carriage make a sharp turn, so that the iron vertebrae that would have hit the roof only hit the wheels. Although the carriage turned sideways and the horse was frightened, He ran around, but at least Qin Shihuang was not seriously injured and died suddenly.

In this way, although Zhao Gao lost an arm, what he got in exchange was probably a promotion to a higher position and the emperor's trust...

"Is Zhao Gao also cheating?"

Hei Fu was a little unhappy, but deep down, he found that he was relieved that Qin Shihuang survived.

This emperor with a distinctive personality longed for immortality, but all mortals are mortal, and no one can escape the curse of flesh and blood. But Hei Fu felt that Qin Shi Huangdi should not die in such a useless way...

As for Qin Shihuang himself, he may have been frightened and slightly injured, but was not seriously injured. The only problem is that his whereabouts have always been mysterious, and he became even more vigilant after the assassination.

Even if he showed up and let the people of Donghai County see that he was fine, it would be impossible for other counties to see this scene on television due to the geographical isolation. As a result, rumors naturally started to spread as people spread the news.

Even so, Heifu was still not completely reassured until Qin Shihuang learned that rumors were spreading in various places and issued an oral edict. Not only Jiaodong, but also the governors of counties and counties in Qi, Chu and Liang areas were to beat drums in front of the county and temples to summon the heads of Guizhou. , read this sentence to them:

"I am at peace, and the world is at peace. How is Guizhou Province at peace?"

This oral instruction is very Qin Shihuang's style: short, without adding a word of nonsense, but the meaning is clearly stated!

To the officials and heads of Guizhou, this was the emperor reporting to them that he was safe!

But for those with ulterior motives, this sentence is Qin Shihuang's contemptuous declaration and the loudest response to the rumors:

"You troublemakers, I'm fine!"

"There is nothing wrong with my world. All your plans are in vain. Just be honest and do whatever you need to do!"

Seeing that these words shocked the tens of millions of people in the Jimo Township School into silence, Hei Fu couldn't help but sigh, only Qin Shi Huang himself had such ability to suppress the chaos in the noisy world with just one sentence!

After a while, everyone came to their senses. Those Luzuo Yongbao who had become good officials and citizens and were accustomed to shouting "long live" to the emperor's carriage during the time when Qin Shi Huang stayed in Jimo began to pray for the emperor and congratulate each other. The Jimo market seems to have returned to normal order.

This time, no one dared to spread rumors easily.

Because Qin Shihuang is probably really still alive! He also spread the word orally and told the people personally that he was fine!

For a moment, Xiaoxiao kept silent.

In short, seeing this situation, Heifu sighed and couldn't help but think of a poem.

"In this small world, a few flies hit the wall.

Buzzing, a few screams, a few sobs.

The ants are attracted by the locust tree and exaggerate the country, but it is not easy for the earthworm to shake the tree! "

Later generations have a saying: Everyone is destined to die. It may be heavier than Mount Tai or lighter than a feather!

However, Qin Shihuang's life-and-death struggle was no longer limited to Mount Tai, but half of the world was weighing on the other side of the scale!

Perhaps this is the weight of a "great leader". His life and death can be regarded as the dividing point of the era, just like the alternation of the sun and the moon.

"The afterglow of the setting sun is still shining brightly. Now that the First Emperor is gone, his remaining power is shocking to the world, not to mention that he is still there?"

All the plans ended here, but Heifu's eyes turned to the distance again.

"The undercurrent in Jiaodong was suppressed by one sentence, but what about other places?"

What he has to consider next is the subsequent impact of this accident, and how he can make the most profit from the aftermath!

…
